Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This page covers two things: this website (tolgapol.com), and Marketing OS, a personal marketing-automation and API-integration toolkit that I (Tolga Polat) build and operate for my own use.

This website

tolgapol.com is a static personal page. It does not use cookies, does not run analytics or tracking scripts, and does not collect any personal data from visitors.

Marketing OS

Marketing OS is not a public product or service. It is software I run myself, on my own infrastructure, to manage advertising and analytics accounts that I own or am directly authorized to administer — for my own business activities and for a small number of clients I work with directly.

It connects to platform APIs (for example Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and similar advertising/analytics platforms) using OAuth or service-account credentials that I control, in order to:

  • read performance and configuration data from those accounts
  • generate reports and recommendations
  • make changes to campaigns or content when I direct it to

Data retrieved this way is used only for the account it belongs to, stays within my own infrastructure, and is never sold, shared with third parties, or used to build audiences or profiles outside the account it came from.
